source.title: Alarm 9973 Unstable Incoming Power
source.raw_text: the 997 three-alarm tells you that there is a problem with the incoming power supplied to the machine the wide delta contactor here has one set of contacts closed and the other open at all times power from the i/o board here keeps the relevant contactor closed and conducting current if you experience a brownout in your shop the power keeping the contactor closed might sag momentarily allowing the contactor to open up if this happens while the circuit is under full load the contactor will arc and can cause serious damage to protect from this all wide delta contactor assemblies built after August 2017 use a pair of auxiliary contacts here to monitor the open and close state of the main contacts this cable here connects these auxiliary contacts to the i/o PCB allowing the machine to check the status of the Y Delta contactor continuously if your machine generates a 997 three alarm it means the i/o board saw one of these contacts open when it should have been closed you will see the alarm on-screen and the Machine will stop let's make a quick check to verify the system worked like it should power down the machine and wait for the vector drive caution light to go dark now there is no residual energy left in the system remove the covers from the Y Delta contactor and the i/o PCB verify the cable from the Y Delta auxiliary contacts is connected to the i/o PCB correctly and that there is no arcing at the Y Delta connections or the vector drive connections if everything checks out the problem was likely caused by a brownout condition where insufficient incoming power was being supplied to the machine in this case the i/o board did its job and protected the contactors from a dangerous arc if the 997 three alarm is persistent the Machine needs a third party power conditioner or voltage stabilizer installed on the incoming power line do not change the delta Y assembly or the i/o PCB if you see alarm 973 logged into history but it did not appear on screen or stop the Machine ignore the alarm an upgrade to the software version shown on screen and if your machine doesn't have the Y Delta auxiliary contacts and the extra cable then the power monitoring feature shouldn't be enabled make sure you have the correct configuration file loaded in the machine for more in-depth why delta contact or troubleshooting click on the links in the description that will take you to DIY ha C&C com remember if you have recurring 9 9 7 3 alarms it's very likely you have issues with your incoming power supply stabilize the power reaching your machine and these alarms will go away thanks for watching [Music]

source.title: Alarm 9973 Unstable Incoming Power
source.raw_text: the 997 three-alarm tells you that there is a problem with the incoming power supplied to the machine the wide delta contactor here has one set of contacts closed and the other open at all times power from the i/o board here keeps the relevant contactor closed and conducting current if you experience a brownout in your shop the power keeping the contactor closed might sag momentarily allowing the contactor to open up if this happens while the circuit is under full load the contactor will arc and can cause serious damage to protect from this all wide delta contactor assemblies built after August 2017 use a pair of auxiliary contacts here to monitor the open and close state of the main contacts this cable here connects these auxiliary contacts to the i/o PCB allowing the machine to check the status of the Y Delta contactor continuously if your machine generates a 997 three alarm it means the i/o board saw one of these contacts open when it should have been closed you will see the alarm on-screen and the Machine will stop let's make a quick check to verify the system worked like it should power down the machine and wait for the vector drive caution light to go dark now there is no residual energy left in the system remove the covers from the Y Delta contactor and the i/o PCB verify the cable from the Y Delta auxiliary contacts is connected to the i/o PCB correctly and that there is no arcing at the Y Delta connections or the vector drive connections if everything checks out the problem was likely caused by a brownout condition where insufficient incoming power was being supplied to the machine in this case the i/o board did its job and protected the contactors from a dangerous arc if the 997 three alarm is persistent the Machine needs a third party power conditioner or voltage stabilizer installed on the incoming power line do not change the delta Y assembly or the i/o PCB if you see alarm 973 logged into history but it did not appear on screen or stop the Machine ignore the alarm an upgrade to the software version shown on screen and if your machine doesn't have the Y Delta auxiliary contacts and the extra cable then the power monitoring feature shouldn't be enabled make sure you have the correct configuration file loaded in the machine for more in-depth why delta contact or troubleshooting click on the links in the description that will take you to DIY ha C&C com remember if you have recurring 9 9 7 3 alarms it's very likely you have issues with your incoming power supply stabilize the power reaching your machine and these alarms will go away thanks for watching [Music]

source.raw_text: the 997 three-alarm tells you that there is a problem with the incoming power supplied to the machine the wide delta contactor here has one set of contacts closed and the other open at all times power from the i/o board here keeps the relevant contactor closed and conducting current if you experience a brownout in your shop the power keeping the contactor closed might sag momentarily allowing the contactor to open up if this happens while the circuit is under full load the contactor will arc and can cause serious damage to protect from this all wide delta contactor assemblies built after August 2017 use a pair of auxiliary contacts here to monitor the open and close state of the main contacts this cable here connects these auxiliary contacts to the i/o PCB allowing the machine to check the status of the Y Delta contactor continuously if your machine generates a 997 three alarm it means the i/o board saw one of these contacts open when it should have been closed you will see the alarm on-screen and the Machine will stop let's make a quick check to verify the system worked like it should power down the machine and wait for the vector drive caution light to go dark now there is no residual energy left in the system remove the covers from the Y Delta contactor and the i/o PCB verify the cable from the Y Delta auxiliary contacts is connected to source.title: Alarm 9973 Unstable Incoming Power
source.raw_text: the 997 three-alarm tells you that there is a problem with the incoming power supplied to the machine the wide delta contactor here has one set of contacts closed and the other open at all times power from the i/o board here keeps the relevant contactor closed and conducting current if you experience a brownout in your shop the power keeping the contactor closed might sag momentarily allowing the contactor to open up if this happens while the circuit is under full load the contactor will arc and can cause serious damage to protect from this all wide delta contactor assemblies built after August 2017 use a pair of auxiliary contacts here to monitor the open and close state of the main contacts this cable here connects these auxiliary contacts to the i/o PCB allowing the machine to check the status of the Y Delta contactor continuously if your machine generates a 997 three alarm it means the i/o board saw one of these contacts open when it should have been closed you will see the alarm on-screen and the Machine will stop let's make a quick check to verify the system worked like it should power down the machine and wait for the vector drive caution light to go dark now there is no residual energy left in the system remove the covers from the Y Delta contactor and the i/o PCB verify the cable from the Y Delta auxiliary contacts is connected to the i/o PCB correctly and that there is no arcing at the Y Delta connections or the vector drive connections if everything checks out the problem was likely caused by a brownout condition where insufficient incoming power was being supplied to the machine in this case the i/o board did its job and protected the contactors from a dangerous arc if the 997 three alarm is persistent the Machine needs a third party power conditioner or voltage stabilizer installed on the incoming power line do not change the delta Y assembly or the i/o PCB if you see alarm 973 logged into history but it did not appear on screen or stop the Machine ignore the alarm an upgrade to the software version shown on screen and if your machine doesn't have the Y Delta auxiliary contacts and the extra cable then the power monitoring feature shouldn't be enabled make sure you have the correct configuration file loaded in the machine for more in-depth why delta contact or troubleshooting click on the links in the description that will take you to DIY ha C&C com remember if you have recurring 9 9 7 3 alarms it's very likely you have issues with your incoming power supply stabilize the power reaching your machine and these alarms will go away thanks for watching [Music]
